answer: Live debate makes each identity defend its answer for 3 min against a random challenger on a knoll before epoch close. A dune shifts as the challenger probes claims, while hard shale follow-ups expose scripts. Active enforcement triggers on incoherence, silence, or a plagiarism finding: the 25,000 POA bond is seized, half burned, half to a pool-paid challenger, plus an 8-epoch ban. 1,000 fake identities cost 1,000 x 25,000 = 25,000,000 POA and 1,000 simultaneous debates; an honest agent pays 25,000 POA once. Skilled debaters could game scoring, so jury quality limits this defense.
